skill.name: gitlab-mr-issue
skill.description: Use the GitLab CLI to view, create, and update merge requests and issues, including comments, diffs, and team-formatted descriptions.
skill.summary: Guides GitLab CLI workflows for merge requests and issues.
skill.author: DCjanus

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged Markdown command examples and a high-entropy heuristic, but the reviewed file is plain GitLab CLI documentation. No prompt injection, obfuscated payload, filesystem traversal, or hidden execution path was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: The skill relies on state-changing GitLab CLI commands.
remediation.suggestion: Keep commands explicit and require the user to confirm project, target branch, labels, assignees, and destructive options before running create or update actions.

remediation.issue: Examples use shell placeholders and command substitution.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to quote substituted values and review generated command text before execution, especially for titles, labels, comments, and branch names.

static_findings.snippet: - `glab auth status` 读取当前实例及 “Logged in to <host> as <user>” 行。
- 直接取用户名:`GITLAB_HOST=<host> glab api /user | jq -r '.username'`(依赖本机 `jq`,若已设全局 `GITLAB_HOST` 可直接 `
- 自建实例优先通过环境变量 `GITLAB_HOST` 指定;如需单次覆盖,可在命令前加 `GITLAB_HOST=<host>` 或用 `-R group/project`。
- 输出格式默认够用,若需机器可读用 `--output json`。
- 只看正文:`glab issue view <id|url>`.
- 带讨论:`glab issue view <id|url> --comments`(必要时加 `--system-logs`)。
- 列表:`glab issue list --state opened --per-page 50 [-R group/project]`;过滤标签用 `--label foo,bar`。
- 添加评论:`glab issue note <id> -m "comment"`。
- MR 概览(按需取字段):`glab mr view <id|branch|url> --output json | jq -r '.title,.state,.author.username,.
- 查看 diff:`glab mr diff <id|branch> --color=never`;需要原始 patch 用 `--raw`。
- 相关 issue:`glab mr issues <id>`。
1) 确保本地分支已推送且 `git status` 干净。
2) 标题风格:英文、遵循语义化提交规范(如 `feat(scope): short summary`),保持简洁且描述核心目的;即使标题要求中文,语义化前缀(如 `feat`、`fix`)仍需英文。
- `## Summary`:用 1-2 条短句从功能层面概述目的与影响,强调功能变更而非逐条代码变更;跨层(如 Service/DAO)且语义一致的改动应合并为一次功能描述。
- `## Key changes`:3-5 条要点列出主要变更。
- `## Constraints / tradeoffs`:若存在约束、限制或非理想选择,简要说明。
- `## Testing`:验证方式、命令或场景;未测试需注明原因。
- `## Notes`(可选):review 关注点、发布注意事项或后续计划。

content.value_statement: GitLab issue and merge request work often needs exact CLI commands and consistent descriptions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through glab workflows for viewing, creating, and updating GitLab items.
actual_capabilities: Checks GitLab CLI authentication and current user context.
Views GitLab issues with optional comments and system logs.
Lists open issues with pagination, project selection, and label filters.
Views merge request metadata, diffs, related issues, and raw patches.
Creates or updates merge requests and issues with non-interactive glab commands.
Provides a structured merge request description format with summary, changes, testing, and notes.
limitations: Requires a working glab installation and valid GitLab authentication.
Some commands depend on jq, git, and the current repository state.
It does not verify repository permissions or project policy before commands run.
Create and update actions can modify remote GitLab data.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Merge Request
use_cases.description: Draft a non-interactive GitLab merge request with a clear title, formatted description, labels, and source branch.

use_cases.title: Review MR Context
use_cases.description: Inspect merge request details, linked issues, comments, and diffs before review or follow-up changes.

use_cases.title: Triage GitLab Issues
use_cases.description: List, view, comment on, and update issues across a GitLab project with consistent CLI commands.

prompt_templates.title: View an Issue
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for reading an issue safely.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to view GitLab issue 123 with comments. Summarize the current status and any requested follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Merge Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to inspect merge request 45. Include the title, state, author, related issues, and the main diff themes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Merge Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a non-interactive create workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a GitLab merge request from the current branch to main. Draft a semantic title and a concise description with summary, key changes, constraints, and testing.

prompt_templates.title: Update an Existing MR
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that must preserve existing context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to update merge request 45. Read the current title and description first, then propose the exact title and description changes before applying them.

output_examples.input: Review merge request 45 and tell me what changed.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes the merge request title, status, author, linked issues, and main diff areas. It highlights review risks and names any missing testing notes.

output_examples.input: Create an issue for the failing payment retry job.
output_examples.output: The response drafts a clear issue title, a short context and expected-result description, suggested labels, and the final GitLab issue URL after creation.

output_examples.input: Update the MR description after I added integration tests.
output_examples.output: The response reads the existing description, adds the testing update in the right section, and confirms the changed merge request URL.

best_practices: Confirm the GitLab host, project, and current user before creating or updating remote items.
Read the current issue or merge request content before changing titles, descriptions, or labels.
Keep merge request descriptions focused on what changed, why it matters, impact, constraints, and testing.
anti_patterns: Do not run create or update commands without confirming the target project and branch.
Do not replace an existing description before reading its current content.
Do not use vague merge request titles that omit the feature, fix, or affected area.

faq.question: Does this skill require GitLab CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. It assumes glab is installed, authenticated, and able to access the target GitLab project.

faq.question: Can it work with self-managed GitLab instances?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions support setting GITLAB_HOST or using a repository selector for a specific group and project.

faq.question: Can it create merge requests without opening an editor?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill uses non-interactive glab commands with explicit titles, descriptions, branches, labels, and confirmation flags.

faq.question: Does it read comments and diffs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes commands for viewing issue comments, merge request details, merge request diffs, and related issues.

faq.question: Can it modify existing issues or merge requests?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes update guidance, but it requires reading the current title or description before making changes.

faq.question: What should users review before running commands?
faq.answer: Users should review the host, project, branch, labels, assignees, privacy settings, and any text that will be posted to GitLab.
